Updated the TurnDeduplicator section for #3559 against turn-idempotency.ts, turn-deduplicator.ts, sqlite-turn-dedup-persistence.ts, the sendTurn claim path in orchestration-service.ts, EventStore.claimChatTurn and chat-primary-stream.ts: claim now returns owner, contended or indeterminate; beginInvocation is durable before the boundary moves to invoking and the provider call; a dead owner's claim is reclaimed only while pending; begun and legacy rows answer indeterminate; /chat claims are untracked. Removed the false claim that the invocation boundary still admits a reclaimed call, since boot recovery deletes the dead boundary row. Other sections citing these sources describe unchanged behaviour.
